AUTHOR: Coro, G; Walsh, MB
TITLE: An intelligent and cost-effective remote underwater video device for fish size monitoring
REGION: Not specified (deep-water baited videos incl. NOAA; shallow self-recorded site)
SPECIES: large fish events (sharks, tunas, mantas/rays; T1 also giant squid)
DATA: 5 test cases: T1 = 15 short deep-water baited videos (100-700 m, IR); T2-T5 = shallow (~3 m) unbaited self-made videos; development set = synthetic Maya animations
V_EV: Sec 2.10: 'depths ranging between ~100m and ~700m, with IR illumination and visibility up to ~1m' / T2: 'visible light had a ~10m maximum visibility.'
D2: parameters tuned on synthetic development videos; tested on 5 separate real test cases
D_EV: Sec 2.9-2.10: development videos 'built by modelling, rigging, and animating fishes'; 'tested on five videos recorded by underwater remote devices in real deployment scenarios'
R_EV: Sec 2.3: Tiny-YOLO 'distributed as pre-trained with ... COCO'; tuned on synthetic development set and tested on real deep/shallow videos (Table 3); no in-domain performance reported
C_EV: Sec 3.1: 'The tuning of UDMOS on the development set estimated the values of all configuration parameters... The optimal deep learning threshold... (0.1)'
E_EV: Sec 2.11/Table 3: only 15-s segment-level 'Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F-measure' of large-fish events reported
ARCH: Tiny-YOLO v3 (COCO pretrained, class-agnostic boxes) + Otsu-based unsupervised detector + movement detector + heuristic size analyser
METR: Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F-measure on 15-s segments
NOTE: Event-triggered recording of large fish; no model training on real data (thresholds tuned on synthetic Maya videos). Visibility given as approximate metres per test case (~1 m deep, ~10 m shallow), method of estimation not stated; coded 기타 정량 with V6=P because per-case results are confounded with density/illumination described qualitatively. Platform mixes baited deep-water and unbaited shallow remote cameras. Event presence detection treated as detection metric (E1=없음). Threshold tuned on dev set -> justified (C_ALL P).
